responsibility: Defines the master declarative list of supported AVR cores and concrete MCU names, along with their architecture class, device feature bits, predefined macro name, memory layout defaults, flash size, and program-memory offset. This `.def` file is not executable backend logic itself; instead it is the authoritative input consumed by `avr-devices.cc`, the specs-file generator, the texinfo generator, and multilib-generation scripts, making it the central registry that keeps device recognition, documentation, and per-device driver behavior in sync.
